My thoughts are with the Gabbard family as they face this difficult diagnosis, and I wish them strength in the days ahead.
 
But let’s be clear: Donald Trump must not treat this vacancy as another opportunity to reward loyalty over competence. The DNI’s job is to protect the American people with facts, judgment, and independence — not to launder conspiracy theories or tell the President what he wants to hear. 

Senate Democrats will fight any nominee who puts Trump’s politics ahead of America’s

Trump and Republicans are taking a break from trying to use taxpayer funds for his gold-plated ballroom and $1.8 billion MAGA slush fund to visit the Hudson Valley today.
 
Here is the reality facing families in Rockland County:
 
⛽ Gas is nearly $4.75 because of his war in Iran
🛒 20% higher grocery bills
🥦 175,000 NYers already kicked off SNAP 
🏥 27,000 families in NY-17 are losing health care


CBS 6 Albany - WRGB (@CBS6Albany)

This month, we celebrate and recognize Jewish American Heritage Month. Every year, we take this time to celebrate the immense contributions of Jewish Americans to the fabric of American society and reflect on the rich history of Jewish Americans across every walk of life in our country.

This year, Jewish American Heritage Month comes at a time when antisemitism continues to rise and we must grapple with deadly attacks against Jewish Americans, from DC to CO to MI. Hate must be intolerable and c

Thank you to my friend, Stephen Colbert. 

He has been an icon of late night comedy, a warrior for free speech, and a much needed voice in our politics. 

I have no doubt he will continue to be all of that and much more. Congratulations on an amazing run, @StephenAtHome!

Instead of lowering costs and helping the American people, Republicans are too busy bowing down to Trump.

Video

Trump in 2021: To the J6 insurrectionists who attacked police, you will pay.
 
Trump in 2026: To the J6 insurrectionists who attacked police, American taxpayers will pay you.

Video

Senate Democrats held strong. Senate Republicans are in chaos.

This is just the beginning – we will keep fighting this bill, filled with Trump vanity projects and billions for his rogue police forces, for as long as it takes.


Jake Sherman (@JakeSherman)

🚨🚨BREAKING NEWS: THE SENATE will go home until June, leaving the reconciliation bill unfinished.

THUNE just told senators in the room. 

All because of the DOJ weaponization fund. 

House is expected to follow suit soon. 

me and @AndrewDesi

Americans are getting absolutely crushed by surging costs as we head into Memorial Day Weekend. Compared to last year:

Hot dogs are up 12%
Buns are up 20%
Ketchup is up 14%
Watermelon is up 17%
Lettuce is up 19%
Tomatoes are up 22%

The price of gas? Up 42% from this time last year thanks to Trump’s war with Iran

Trump’s nearly $2 billion dollar MAGA slush fund is the most blatant act of corruption in American history

That’s why the very first amendment I will offer during vote-a-rama today will be to block this slush fund

Trump doesn’t have to pay his taxes, but he’s more than happy to put your tax dollars in the pockets of his cronies, criminals, and cop-killing insurrectionists

No matter what’s in their bill, Democrats will force Republicans to vote again and again on their ridiculous priorities:

Trump’s billion-dollar ballroom
Trump’s insurrectionist slush fund
Trump’s reckless war

Every vote will show that Democrats are standing up for America, while the GOP sells out to Trump

Where the hell is the Republican bill?

Video

Republicans are helping Trump STEAL from the American people to fund his ballroom and his MAGA slush fund.
 
Democrats will offer amendment after amendment to lower costs on everything from health care to groceries to gasoline.
 
The contrast could not be clearer.

Video

Democrats are going to force Senate Republicans to vote on amendment after amendment about Trump’s ballroom, about Trump’s corrupt slush fund, and the rising costs of Trump’s war.

They will not be able to hide.

Barney Frank and I came to Congress together. The minute he got here, he was a fountain of energy, intelligence, morality, and creativity – all aimed at making the world a better place. He never stopped and has had an amazing impact.

We remained good friends after he retired, and we would continually discuss his plethora of incredible ideas to improve this country and this world that he loved so much. I will miss him as a friend, and the world will miss him as a great humanitarian leader.

Trump’s DOJ granted him and his family immunity from tax audits, giving his family a license to commit tax fraud.

Trump doesn’t have to pay his taxes. Meanwhile he’s using American tax dollars to line the pockets of his family and his far-right cronies.
